summary: Nebius for Startups offer for NVIDIA Inception members: $5,000 in introductory credits for training or inference on Nebius on demand, plus up to $150,000 in compute savings. Due to demand, selection is temporarily limited to AI-native startups with $5M+ in venture backing, with preference for startups backed by Nebius's partner VC firms. All applications go to a waitlist, acceptance is not guaranteed, and applicants should use a company email address.
claim_steps: Apply on the Nebius Inception offering page using a company email address
Wait for waitlist review and acceptance

social_proof.title: Exclusive offer for NVIDIA Inception Members
social_proof.text: $5,000 in introductory credits. Free credits you can use immediately to start training models or running inference on Nebius on demand. Up to $150,000 in compute savings. Nebius for Startups currently accepts AI-native startup founders with $5M+ raised. All applications will be added to our waitlist for consideration.
